title.narrative: Financial Market Development and Inclusion Program (Subprogram 2)

description.narrative: The proposed subprogram 2 supports the government's main reform priorities in developing and making the finance sector more inclusive, and represents a medium- to long-term partnership between the Asian Development Bank (ADB), the government, and the Financial Services Authority (OJK). The government's priority areas include (i) strengthening the regulatory structure for financial stability, (ii) deepening the financial market, and (iii) enhancing financial inclusion with a focus on promoting access to financial services to poor households and women.
